Definition: neuter of a derivative of G2198; a live thing, i.e. an animal:--beast.
BiblicalUsage: Zoon is a living creature, and in Revelation the four living creatures stand around the throne, full of eyes before and behind, crying 'Holy, holy, holy' without rest day or night. One has the face of a lion, one of a calf, one of a man, one of a flying eagle — and the Lamb stands in their midst, having been slain. The same word is used for the beasts of the earth and the sea elsewhere, but here the living creatures are the worshippers closest to the throne.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the four living creatures show me what worship is for: beings full of eyes to see God's glory, and full of voices to praise it without stopping. That is the life I was made for — to see Him and to say holy.
